title: Additional Documents Required for B.Tech DASA Students at Physical Reporting (2025 batch)
important_note: These are ADDITIONAL documents specific to DASA students, produced in ORIGINAL plus a photocopy at physical reporting, in addition to whatever was already submitted to DASA at the time of admission.
documents_required: Provisional Admission Letter (issued from DASA 2025), signed by candidate
JEE 2025 score card issued by NTA (self-attested copy), if applicable
10th Standard/Matriculation or equivalent certificate (or govt-issued certificate) as proof of date of birth and name
Passport and Visa (Nepal nationals without passport: Authenticated Citizenship Card) and/or PIO/OCI card as applicable
Medical Certificate (specified format - Annexure 10 of DASA 2025 Information Brochure)
Mark sheet/grade card and Pass certificate of qualifying examination (or School Certificate proving completion of 11th & 12th if results awaited - Annexure 14)
Mark sheets of 10th, 11th and 12th (or equivalent examinations)
Certificate from School authorities proving completion of 11th & 12th - Annexure 11, on school letterhead
For foreign qualifications not listed in Annexure 2 of DASA brochure: AIU equivalence certificate (www.aiu.ac.in)
School Leaving / Transfer Certificate from institution last attended
For Indian citizens who completed 11th/12th abroad: proof certificate as per Annexure 13 (if not clear from School Leaving Certificate)
Character and Conduct Certificate from institution last attended (if qualifying exam passed in 2024-2025); OR from a Gazetted Officer issued on/after 1 March 2025 (if passed in earlier years)
CIWG category candidates additionally need: copy of parent's passport, copy of parent's visa valid in 2025, copy of parent's work permit valid in 2025, employer certificate (Annexure 12 format)
important_conditions: Admission is provisional and subject to cancellation if original documents are not produced at physical reporting.
If parents cannot travel with the candidate, a Gazetted-officer-attested copy of relevant passport/visa pages plus an authorization letter may be submitted instead.
quick_answer: DASA B.Tech students must bring ORIGINALS + photocopies of: DASA provisional letter, JEE/10th DOB proof, passport & visa (or PIO/OCI), medical certificate, all mark sheets (10th/11th/12th), school leaving certificate, and character certificate. CIWG candidates need extra parent-employment documents.

title: Schedule & Document Checklist for MCA Physical Reporting (NIMCET Regular & SFS, Academic Year 2025-26)

reporting_schedule.venue: Academic Section, 3rd Floor, Administrative Building, NIT Delhi, Plot No. FA7, Zone P1, GT Karnal Road, Delhi-110036

what_to_bring: Self-attested copies of all documents in the checklist
Failing to bring required documents may result in cancellation of admission

documents_checklist.item: Provisional seat allotment letter (downloaded from NIMCET website)
Printout of registration form with locked choices
Original Admission Letter and Original Document Verification Certificate (DVC) issued by NIMCET
Birth certificate (competent authority) or Class X board certificate as DOB proof
Four passport-size colour photographs
Provisional Seat Allotment Letter (last round)
Proof of payment of seat acceptance fee
Class X mark sheet and certificate
Class XII / Diploma mark sheet (if applicable)
Class XII / Diploma pass certificate (if applicable)
Original grade/mark sheet of qualifying examination, all semesters
Degree certificate of qualifying examination
Course completion certificate from Head of University/Institute (if result awaited)
Character Certificate, Transfer Certificate & Migration Certificate
Photo ID proof as per Govt. of India norms, especially Aadhaar Card
Valid category certificate (OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS) - format on NIMCET website. OBC-NCL/EWS certificate must be issued on/after 1 April 2025
Undertaking for OBC-NCL candidates only (Annexure III)
Certificate of Persons with Disability, for PwD candidates only
Medical Fitness Certificate (Annexure V)

Affidavits: study-gap affidavit (Rs.10 stamp paper, if applicable), student anti-ragging affidavit (online generated), parent/guardian anti-ragging affidavit (online generated); hostellers need 2 sets of the anti-ragging affidavits
Undertaking by the student (Institute format, Annexure II)
Undertaking for late submission of documents under special circumstances, if applicable (Annexure IV)

additional_notes: If original documents/certificates are not in English/Hindi, a certified English/Hindi translation is required during verification.
Students should check the NIT Delhi website regularly for class schedule, orientation, roll number and institute email updates (these are shared only after physical reporting).
quick_answer: MCA (NIMCET) physical reporting: bring original admission letter/DVC, 10th & 12th/UG mark sheets & certificates, migration & character certificate, Aadhaar, 4 passport photos, category certificate (if applicable), medical fitness certificate, and anti-ragging affidavits (2 sets if hosteller).
